title: Atlassian - Login / Signup with Microsoft not working
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: Login / Signup with Microsoft not working
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: 2020-09-28T23:39:35.039Z
Resolved: 2020-09-29T01:03:24.701Z
Updates:
- 2020-09-29T01:03:24.701Z: resolved - Between 2020-09-28 21:32 UTC to 2020-09-29 00:09 UTC, we experienced a degradation in functionality for users attempting to authenticate using Microsoft. This affected Confluence, Jira Core, Jira Service Desk, Jira Software, Opsgenie, Atlassian Developer, Trello, and Atlassian Bitbucket. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
- 2020-09-28T23:39:35.156Z: identified - We are investigating reports of intermittent errors for some Atlassian, Confluence, Jira Core, Jira Service Desk, Jira Software, Opsgenie, Atlassian Developer, Trello, and Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud customers. We will provide more details once we identify the root cause.

incident.name: Login / Signup with Microsoft not working

incident_updates.body: Between 2020-09-28 21:32 UTC to 2020-09-29 00:09 UTC, we experienced a degradation in functionality for users attempting to authenticate using Microsoft. This affected Confluence, Jira Core, Jira Service Desk, Jira Software, Opsgenie, Atlassian Developer, Trello, and Atlassian Bitbucket. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.

We are investigating reports of intermittent errors for some Atlassian, Confluence, Jira Core, Jira Service Desk, Jira Software, Opsgenie, Atlassian Developer, Trello, and Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud customers. We will provide more details once we identify the root cause.
